cards.description:

cards.description:

cards.name: S2. Retrieval methods: BM25, TF-IDF, dense, hybrid - Qiling
cards.description:
Sprint 2 · 22–28 Sep 2026

4 retrievers in rra/retrieval.py. Hybrid uses reciprocal rank fusion of BM25 and dense. Dense uses sentence-transformers (MiniLM), with an offline LSA fallback.

cards.name: S2. Cited-answer generator + INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE gate - Dhanush
cards.description:
Sprint 2 · 22–28 Sep 2026

Every answer sentence cites its source chunk, e.g. [dpr:11]. Replies INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when retrieved passages don't cover the question.
Two generation modes:

Extractive (offline): copies the best-matching retrieved sentences. Done, and used for all current results.

Language-model generation: writes the answer from the same passages under the same citation rules. Set up but not yet run (see Blocked).

cards.name: S2. Pipeline tests & run instructions - Amritpal
cards.description:
Sprint 2 · 22–28 Sep 2026

tests/test_pipeline.py runs on synthetic PDFs without network. README documents every command.

cards.name: S2. Sprint 2 review & retrospective - Chetan
cards.description:
Sprint 2 · 22–28 Sep 2026

Planning: 22 Sep 2026. Split the Week 7 prototype into tasks: ingestion/chunking, retrieval, answer generation and evaluation.
Stand-ups: no formal daily stand-ups. The team shared quick progress updates as tasks finished.
Review: 26 Sep 2026. Compared BM25, TF-IDF, dense and hybrid retrieval against the Walert-style baseline.
Decision at review: test all 20 chunking × retrieval combinations (carried into Sprint 3).
Retrospective: the validation check paid off by catching extraction errors early. Working dates weren't recorded, so the team now updates Trello as tasks happen.

cards.name: S3. Evaluate all 20 retrieval configurations - Deboprio
cards.description:
Sprint 3 · 29 Sep–5 Oct 2026 (Week 8: evaluation + refinement)

Evaluation run 20260929-074348 UTC (29 Sep 2026, about 17:43 Melbourne time) on corpus 17baac618aa0, k = 5. Results in results/latest.json and results/report.html.

| | Baseline fixed-200/bm25 | Best fixed-400/hybrid+route |
|---|---|---|
| Recall@5 | 0.59 | 0.71 |
| MRR | 0.42 | 0.32 |
| Citation precision | 0.81 | 1.00 |
| Unsupported declined | 6/7 | 7/7 |

cards.name: S3. Analyse retrieval failures - Deboprio
cards.description:
Sprint 3 · 29 Sep–5 Oct 2026

Every failure labelled (retrieval\_miss, wrong\_paper_cited, and others).
Main finding: wrong-paper retrieval. Shared words like "retrieval" and "RAG" outweighed the paper named in the question (e.g. RAG chunks outranked Walert's for a Walert question). Comparison questions often retrieved only one of their two papers.
Other findings: dense (MiniLM) alone weakest (Recall@5 0.35–0.47); bigger chunks inflate recall; remaining misses mostly vocabulary mismatch.

cards.name: S3. Paper-aware routing (+route) - Qiling
cards.description:
Sprint 3 · 29 Sep–5 Oct 2026

retrieval.PaperRouter shares the top-k slots among the papers a question names. Raised citation precision to 1.00 for every chunker; Recall@5 0.59 → 0.71 vs baseline.
Caveat: designed after seeing failures on the same 24 questions, so it needs confirming on a held-out set (see To Do).

cards.name: S3. Publish evaluation report - Amritpal
cards.description:
Sprint 3 · 29 Sep–5 Oct 2026

results/report.html, published as "Paper-Grounded RAG Evaluation": full grid of results and every per-question answer.

Every failure labelled (retrieval\_miss, wrong\_paper_cited, and others).
Main finding: wrong-paper retrieval. Shared words like "retrieval" and "RAG" outweighed the paper named in the question (e.g. RAG chunks outranked Walert's for a Walert question). Comparison questions often retrieved only one of their two papers.
Other findings: dense (MiniLM) alone weakest (Recall@5 0.35–0.47); bigger chunks inflate recall; remaining misses mostly vocabulary mismatch.
